Claims of the Rosenberg allodial heirs against Hatzfeldt.

Date span: 1640–1700.

Contents: 1. Claims of the Rosenberg property heirs against Hatzfeldt arising from the sale of Rosenberg properties; receipts for instalments paid, 1640–1653 (1681).
2. Assignment to Hatzfeldt of a claim by Maria Barbara Zöllner von Brand against the Rosenberg property heirs; transfer of the claim to Lieutenant Colonel Georg Christoph von Sparnberg; claims of Rosenberg property heirs against Hatzfeldt, 1653, 1665–1685, 1696.
3. Additional claims by the Rosenberg property heirs against Hatzfeldt arising from the sale of Rosenberg allodial properties, (1640, 1653–1660) 1667–1700.
4. Accounts and correspondence with Rosenberg property heirs, 1678–1682.
5. Claim by Burkhardt Dietrich von Weyler, as heir of the lords von Liebenstein (heirs to Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg's properties), against Counts Franz, Heinrich and Sebastian von Hatzfeldt for payment of 36,663 florins in remaining debts from the sale by Liebenstein to Hatzfeldt of the Rosenberg properties, 1681–1685.

Extent: 1 file.
